sentences.text:
Case :- Criminal Misc. Bail Application No. - 11297 of 2024
Applicant :- Smt. Kaudila @ Renu
Opposite Party :- State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy.

Counsel for Applicant :- Bal Krishna Shukla
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Pankaj Bhatia,J.
1. Heard learned counsel for the applicant as well as learned A.G.A. and perused the record.

2. The applicant seeks enlargement on bail in Fir No.285 of 2024, under Sections 498A, 304B Ipc
and Section 3/4 of D.P. Act, Police Station Kotwali Nanpara, District Bahraich.
3.  It is argued by the Counsel for the applicant that the co-accused has been enlarged on bail vide order dated 19.09.2024 passed in Criminal Misc. Bail Application No.9855 of 2024.

entities.text: Criminal Misc. Bail Application No.9855 of 2024
entities.label: CASE_NUMBER

sentences.text: The applicant is the husband of the deceased.

sentences.text: 4. Learned A.G.A. vehemently opposed the bail prayer.

5. Considering and adopting the same reasoning as contained in the order dated 19.09.2024 and the fact that the applicant has no criminal antecedents and is in custody since 09.08.2024, I am of the view that the applicant is entitled to be released on bail.
Accordingly, the bail application is allowed.

6. Let the applicant Smt. Kaudila @ Renu be released on bail in the aforesaid first information report on her furnishing personal bonds and two reliable sureties of Rs.20,000/- each to the satisfaction of the court concerned with the following conditions:
(a) The applicant shall execute a bond to undertake to attend the hearings;
(b) The applicant shall not commit any offence similar to the offence of which she is accused or suspected of the commission; and (c) The applicant shall not directly or indirectly make any inducement, threat or promise to any person acquainted with the facts of the case so as to dissuade him from disclosing such facts to the Court or to any police officer or tamper with the evidence.
Order Date :- 7.11.2024 akverma  Smt. Kaudila @ Renu vs State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. Home Lko on 7 November, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/177502615/
